items.title: What are data centre and IT infrastructure services?
paragraphs: These services involve the planning, installation, organisation and support of the physical systems required for business computing and connectivity. items.title: Does Integrated Solutions Technology set up server rooms?
paragraphs: Yes. Our server room solutions cover the planning and deployment of equipment infrastructure, including rack arrangements, equipment installation, cabling organisation and relevant supporting requirements based on the project scope.

items.title: What is a rack-and-stack service?
paragraphs: Rack-and-stack involves physically installing suitable IT equipment into server or network racks. It can include equipment positioning, mounting, securing, connecting and organising devices according to the approved deployment requirements.

items.title: Can you install enterprise servers and storage systems?
paragraphs: Yes. Integrated Solutions Technology provides server, storage and related hardware installation services. The activities may include physical deployment, power and network connections, and agreed initial configuration or integration requirements.

paragraphs: Yes. Structured cabling and network installation are offered through our Network & Structured Cabling service division. We can consider these requirements alongside broader server room and IT infrastructure projects.

items.title: Can you help with infrastructure expansion?

items.title: Do you test equipment after installation?

items.title: How long does a data centre or server room installation take?
paragraphs: The timeframe depends on the size of the environment, equipment quantities, site readiness, access conditions, required connections and project complexity. A review of the proposed work helps establish an appropriate project schedule.

items.title: How much does a data centre infrastructure project cost in Nigeria?
paragraphs: The cost depends on the scope of work, equipment requirements, rack capacity, infrastructure condition, installation complexity and supporting systems. An assessment and defined project scope are necessary to prepare a meaningful quotation.

items.title: Does Integrated Solutions Technology provide maintenance and technical support?
paragraphs: Yes. Our wider IT services include infrastructure maintenance, troubleshooting and technical assistance. The available support arrangement should be discussed according to your equipment and operational requirements.

items.title: How do I start a data centre or IT infrastructure project?

items.title: What is structured cabling?
paragraphs: Structured cabling is an organised system of cables, outlets, patch panels and supporting equipment used to connect network devices within a building or facility. It provides a consistent physical foundation for communication and data networks.

items.title: What is the difference between structured cabling and network installation?
paragraphs: Structured cabling focuses on the physical cable infrastructure and its organisation. Network installation is broader and may include switches, routers, wireless access points, device connections and configuration.

items.title: Do you install Cat6 and other network cables?
paragraphs: Structured cabling projects can use suitable copper cable categories, including Cat6, depending on performance requirements, distance, equipment compatibility and applicable installation standards. The appropriate cable specification is determined during project planning.

items.title: How do I know whether my business needs a network upgrade?

items.title: Can you connect different floors or buildings?

items.title: What is the difference between a server and a storage system?
paragraphs: A server provides computing resources for running applications and processing information. A storage system provides capacity for retaining and accessing data. Some servers include internal storage, while larger environments may use dedicated storage equipment.

items.title: Do you provide NAS and SAN storage solutions?
paragraphs: Network Attached Storage (NAS) and Storage Area Network (SAN) are two approaches to shared data storage. The most suitable option depends on business applications, data access requirements, performance expectations and infrastructure compatibility. Availability and implementation scope should be confirmed during consultation.

items.title: Can you upgrade our existing servers instead of replacing them?

items.title: Do you provide server configuration services?

items.title: How can my organisation protect important business data?
paragraphs: Data protection generally involves appropriate backup arrangements, access controls, storage planning, monitoring and tested recovery procedures. The right approach depends on your information systems and the consequences of data loss.

items.title: How much does an enterprise server cost in Nigeria?

items.title: What security and surveillance services does Integrated Solutions Technology provide?
paragraphs: Integrated Solutions Technology provides CCTV installation, video surveillance systems, recording equipment, security system maintenance and related technical solutions for residential, commercial and institutional properties.

items.title: Do you install CCTV cameras for homes and businesses?
paragraphs: Yes. We provide CCTV installation solutions for homes, offices, retail properties, warehouses and other suitable facilities. The recommended system depends on your property layout, monitoring priorities and recording requirements.

items.title: How many CCTV cameras do I need for my property?
paragraphs: The number of cameras depends on your building layout, entrances, monitoring areas, viewing angles and security objectives. A site assessment helps determine suitable camera positions and coverage.

items.title: What is the difference between IP CCTV and analogue CCTV?
paragraphs: IP cameras transmit video data through compatible network infrastructure, while analogue cameras typically use dedicated video connections to compatible recording equipment. The best option depends on system requirements, existing infrastructure and planned expansion.

items.title: Can I view my CCTV cameras remotely?
paragraphs: Many modern surveillance systems support remote viewing through compatible applications or management platforms. This requires appropriate network connectivity, authorised access and secure system configuration.

items.title: Will my CCTV system work without internet access?
paragraphs: Many CCTV installations can record locally without an active internet connection, depending on the equipment and configuration. Internet connectivity is generally required for remote viewing outside the local network.

items.title: Can CCTV cameras record at night?
paragraphs: Yes. Suitable cameras may use infrared illumination, low-light sensors or other night-vision technologies. Actual image quality depends on the camera specifications, lighting conditions and installation environment.

items.title: How long can CCTV footage be stored?
paragraphs: Recording duration depends on the number of cameras, image resolution, recording settings, storage capacity and retention requirements. Storage should be planned around your needs and applicable privacy obligations.

items.title: What happens to my CCTV system during a power outage?
paragraphs: CCTV equipment normally requires electricity to operate. A suitably configured UPS, inverter or battery backup system may keep selected devices running during an outage, subject to available backup capacity.

items.title: Can you upgrade an existing CCTV system?
paragraphs: Yes. Existing installations can be assessed for suitable camera replacements, recording equipment upgrades, storage expansion, cabling improvements and other necessary changes.

items.title: Do you provide CCTV maintenance and repair?
paragraphs: Yes. Our security system services include inspection, troubleshooting, equipment maintenance and suitable upgrade support based on the installed system and agreed scope.

items.title: Do you provide access control systems?
paragraphs: Yes. We provide access control for doors, rooms and restricted areas. We confirm suitable equipment and installation requirements during consultation.

items.title: How much does CCTV installation cost in Nigeria?
paragraphs: The cost depends on the number and type of cameras, recording equipment, storage capacity, cabling, property size, installation complexity and additional requirements. A site assessment helps establish a suitable system and quotation.

items.title: Can you install CCTV across multiple buildings or locations?
paragraphs: Surveillance systems can be planned for multiple buildings or sites, depending on connectivity, recording, monitoring and access requirements. The appropriate architecture depends on the scale and conditions of the project.

items.title: Does CCTV installation require consideration of privacy?
paragraphs: Yes. Camera placement, recorded footage, access permissions and retention arrangements should be planned with appropriate attention to privacy and applicable data protection requirements.
